title: Door open or not detected
causes: The door is not fully shut.
Clothes are caught in the door.
Child Lock is on and the door was opened.
steps: Open the door and remove any clothes caught at the edge.
Close the door firmly until it latches.
Check whether Child Lock is switched on.
Start the cycle again.
technician: If the code stays with the door properly closed, the latch or door sensor may be faulty. Contact Samsung service.

title: Lint filter problem
causes: The lint filter is missing, blocked or not seated correctly.
steps: Remove the lint filter and clean it.
Refit it fully so it sits correctly.
Restart the cycle.
technician: If the code returns with a clean, correctly fitted filter, book a Samsung service visit.

title: Heat exchanger inner cover problem
causes: The inner cover of the heat exchanger is not fitted correctly.
steps: Switch the dryer off.
Check that the heat exchanger inner cover is in place and closed properly.
Restart the cycle.
technician: If the code persists after refitting the cover, contact Samsung service.

title: Drainage problem
causes: The drain hose is bent, damaged or frozen.
The water tank is full.
The drain pump is not working.
steps: Empty the water tank and refit it.
Check that the drain hose is not kinked or damaged.
If the hose is frozen, wrap it in a towel soaked in warm water for about 10 minutes.
Switch the dryer on and restart the cycle.
technician: If the tank is empty and the hose is clear but the code returns, the pump may be faulty. Call Samsung service.

title: Air temperature sensor problem
causes: Lint filter or heat exchanger is clogged.
The vent or airflow path is restricted.
The temperature sensor is faulty.
steps: Clean the lint filter.
Clean the heat exchanger if your model has one.
Check the vent or exhaust for blockages.
Restart the cycle.
technician: If cleaning does not clear the code, the sensor may need replacing. Contact Samsung service.

title: Compressor temperature sensor problem
causes: The lint screen is clogged.
Airflow through the vent system is restricted.
steps: Wait 2 to 3 minutes, then switch the dryer on again.
Clean the lint screen.
Check the vent system for blockages.
Restart the cycle.
technician: If the code keeps coming back, the heat pump system needs checking by Samsung service.

title: Motor problem
causes: The inverter motor did not run as expected.
steps: Make sure the drum is not overloaded.
Restart the cycle.
Unplug the dryer for at least 30 seconds, plug it back in and try again.
technician: If the code returns, the motor or its control needs a technician. Contact Samsung service.

title: Electronic communication error
causes: Internal control parts are not communicating with each other.
steps: Switch the dryer off for 60 seconds.
Switch it back on and restart the cycle.
technician: If the code returns, the control boards need checking. Request Samsung service.

title: Main board and inverter board not communicating
causes: The main control board and inverter board lost communication.
steps: Restart the cycle.
Unplug the dryer for at least 30 seconds, plug it back in and try again.
technician: If the code persists, a technician needs to check the boards and wiring. Contact Samsung service.

title: Overheating or heating problem
causes: Lint filter or vent is blocked, so the dryer runs too hot.
A tripped breaker or low voltage on electric models.
steps: Clean the lint filter.
Check the vent for blockages.
Check your home's breakers and reset any that have tripped.
Restart the cycle.
technician: If the code continues, have an electrician check the supply and book Samsung service for the heating system.

title: Wrong power supply frequency
causes: The mains power frequency does not match what the dryer expects.
steps: Restart the cycle.
Make sure the dryer is plugged directly into a wall socket.
technician: If the code stays, contact Samsung service.

title: Power supply problem
causes: The power supply is not correct.
The plug is loose or not fully in.
An extension lead is being used.
steps: Check the plug is pushed fully into the socket.
Plug the dryer directly into a wall socket on its own circuit, without an extension lead.
Restart the cycle.
technician: If the supply is fine and the code returns, request Samsung service.

title: Door switch fault
causes: The door or lock switch, or its wiring, is faulty.
steps: Close the door firmly and try again.
Unplug the dryer for at least 30 seconds, plug it back in and try again.
technician: The door switch assembly may need replacing. Contact Samsung service.

title: Button stuck
causes: A control panel button is jammed or held down.
steps: Switch the dryer off.
Press and release every button, including the edges, to free a stuck one.
Switch on and try again.
technician: If a button is damaged or the code returns, request Samsung service.

title: Vent clogged (vent test result)
causes: The exhaust vent is blocked by lint or debris.
steps: Clean the lint filter.
Clean the exhaust vent and duct.
Run the vent blockage test again.
technician: If the vent is clean and the result stays the same, contact Samsung service.

title: Software download in progress
causes: The dryer is installing a firmware update.
steps: Do not unplug the dryer or switch off the power.
Wait. The dryer restarts by itself when the update is done.
technician: If dn is still shown after 24 hours, request Samsung service.

title: Child Lock is on
causes: Child Lock has been switched on, so buttons are disabled.
steps: Turn off Child Lock using the button combination in your manual.
technician: This is not a fault. Contact Samsung only if Child Lock cannot be switched off.

title: Gas ignition error
causes: The gas dryer could not ignite.
steps: Switch the dryer off for 2 to 3 minutes.
Switch it on and restart the cycle.
technician: If the code returns, stop using the dryer and call Samsung service. Do not work on gas parts yourself.

title: Drain problem
causes: The drain hose is twisted, kinked or blocked.
The hose end is set too high or is under water.
steps: Straighten the drain hose.
Keep the top of the hose no higher than 1 m from the floor.
Make sure the hose end is not sitting in water.
Restart the dryer.
technician: If the code returns with a clear, correctly placed hose, contact LG service.

title: Exhaust airflow restricted (about 80% blocked)
causes: The lint filter is clogged.
The exhaust duct is crushed, kinked or too long.
The outside vent flap is blocked.
steps: Clean the lint filter and rinse it with warm water if needed.
Check the duct behind the dryer for kinks or crushing.
Make sure the outside vent flap opens fully and remove lint around it.
Use smaller loads until the duct is cleared.
technician: If the code stays after cleaning, hire a duct cleaner or contact LG service.

title: Exhaust airflow restricted (about 90% blocked)
causes: The lint filter is clogged.
The exhaust duct is crushed, kinked or too long.
The outside vent flap is blocked.
steps: Clean the lint filter and rinse it with warm water if needed.
Check the duct behind the dryer for kinks or crushing.
Make sure the outside vent flap opens fully and remove lint around it.
Use smaller loads until the duct is cleared.
technician: If the code stays after cleaning, hire a duct cleaner or contact LG service.

title: Exhaust airflow restricted (about 95% blocked)
causes: The lint filter is clogged.
The exhaust duct is crushed, kinked or too long.
The outside vent flap is blocked.
steps: Clean the lint filter and rinse it with warm water if needed.
Check the duct behind the dryer for kinks or crushing.
Make sure the outside vent flap opens fully and remove lint around it.
Use smaller loads until the duct is cleared.
technician: If the code stays after cleaning, hire a duct cleaner or contact LG service.

title: Lint filter not in place
causes: The lint filter is not inserted correctly.
steps: Take the lint filter out.
Push it back into its housing until it sits fully.
Restart the dryer.
technician: If FO stays with the filter correctly fitted, the sensor may need repair by LG service.

title: Inner lint filter not detected
causes: The magnet in the inner lint filter is missing or out of place.
The magnet holder is damaged.
steps: Remove the inner lint filter and check that its magnet is in place.
Refit the filter correctly.
If the magnet is lost or the holder is broken, buy a new filter.
technician: If the error remains with a good filter, request LG service.

title: No power to the heater
causes: The socket is not giving the correct voltage.
A breaker has tripped.
steps: Switch off the dryer's breaker for at least 10 seconds, then switch it back on.
Restart the dryer.
technician: If it still does not heat, have an electrician check the socket and then contact LG service.

title: Power supply problem
causes: The power cord is loose or the outlet is not wired as required.
steps: Reset the dryer's breaker for at least 10 seconds.
Check that the plug is firmly in a correctly rated, grounded socket.
Restart the dryer.
technician: If the dryer still does not heat, request a repair from LG.

title: Gas supply problem
causes: The gas supply valve is closed.
The gas line is kinked.
steps: Check that the gas supply valve is open.
Check that the gas line is not kinked.
technician: If gas supply is fine and the code returns, call LG service. Do not repair gas parts yourself.

title: Child Lock is on
causes: Child Lock was switched on and stays on after power off.
steps: Switch the dryer on.
Press and hold the Child Lock button for 3 to 5 seconds until CL disappears.
technician: This is not a fault. Contact LG only if Child Lock will not switch off.

title: Add water for steam
causes: The steam feeder is empty during a steam cycle.
steps: Pause the cycle.
Fill the steam feeder with tap water up to the MAX line.
Switch the dryer off and on, choose the steam cycle and press Start.
technician: If the message stays after filling, contact LG service.

title: Drain problem (condensate)
causes: The drain hose is kinked, twisted or blocked.
An extension hose reduces drainage.
steps: Check the drain hose for kinks and blockages.
Use only the original LG drain hose, without an extension.
Press Start/Pause to restart.
technician: If E13 comes back, the dryer needs repair by LG service.

title: Fluff filter blocked
causes: Fluff has built up on the filter.
Fabric softener residue is clogging the mesh.
steps: Remove and empty the fluff filter.
Rinse the filter under warm water to remove residue.
Dry it and refit it.
Clean the filter after every cycle.
technician: If the code stays with a clean filter, book a Bosch service visit.

title: Fluff filter blocked or control relay fault
causes: The fluff filter is blocked.
On some models, a main board relay fault.
steps: Clean the fluff filter and rinse it with warm water.
Switch off power at the plug or breaker for 30 seconds, then restart.
technician: If the code returns after cleaning and a reset, contact Bosch customer service.

title: Condensation drain hose blocked
causes: The condensate drain hose is kinked or blocked.
steps: Check that the drain hose has no kinks.
Carefully remove the hose from the siphon and clean the hose and its connection.
Refit the hose securely.
technician: If the code returns with a clear hose, book a Bosch engineer.

title: Dryer overloaded
causes: Too much laundry in the drum.
steps: Remove some laundry.
Leave about a hand's width of space above the clothes.
Restart the programme.
technician: If the code shows with a normal load, contact Bosch service.

title: Heating circuit fault
causes: A fault in the heating circuit.
steps: Switch the dryer off and unplug it.
Do not try to repair it yourself.
technician: This needs a qualified engineer. Contact Bosch customer service.

title: Electronics fault
causes: An internal electronic fault.
steps: Switch off the dryer.
Unplug it or switch off the breaker for a few minutes, then reconnect.
If the code returns, stop using the dryer.
technician: Only an authorised engineer can fix this. Contact Bosch customer service.

title: Electronics fault
causes: An internal electronic fault.
steps: Switch off the dryer.
Unplug it or switch off the breaker for a few minutes, then reconnect.
If the code returns, stop using the dryer.
technician: Only an authorised engineer can fix this. Contact Bosch customer service.

title: Electronics fault
causes: An internal electronic fault.
steps: Switch off the dryer.
Unplug it or switch off the breaker for a few minutes, then reconnect.
If the code returns, stop using the dryer.
technician: Only an authorised engineer can fix this. Contact Bosch customer service.

steps: Switch off the dryer.

If the code returns, stop using the dryer.
technician: Only an authorised engineer can fix this. Contact Bosch customer service.

title: Electronics fault
causes: An internal electronic fault.
steps: Switch off the dryer.

If the code returns, stop using the dryer.
technician: Only an authorised engineer can fix this. Contact Bosch customer service.

title: Electronics fault
causes: An internal electronic fault.
steps: Switch off the dryer.

If the code returns, stop using the dryer.
technician: Only an authorised engineer can fix this. Contact Bosch customer service.

title: Electronics fault
causes: An internal electronic fault.
steps: Switch off the dryer.
Unplug it or switch off the breaker for a few minutes, then reconnect.
If the code returns, stop using the dryer.
technician: Only an authorised engineer can fix this. Contact Bosch customer service.

title: Overheating or heat pump limescale
causes: Airflow is restricted and the dryer overheats.
Limescale build-up in the heat pump on some models.
steps: Clean the lint filter.
Check the external vent is not blocked, bent or crushed.
Restart the programme.
technician: If the code keeps returning, book a Bosch service visit.

title: Door opened during drying
causes: The door was opened while a cycle was running.
steps: Close the door firmly.
Press Start to resume the cycle.
Use the child lock if needed to stop the door being opened.
technician: If E16 appears with the door closed, the door switch may be faulty. Book a Bosch engineer.

title: Moisture sensor problem
causes: Residue or lint on the moisture sensor strips in the drum.
steps: Unplug the dryer.
Wipe the moisture sensor near the lint filter with a soft cloth and mild cleaner.
Remove any residue, then restart.
technician: If the code persists after cleaning, contact Bosch customer service.

title: Door not closed properly
causes: The door is not fully shut.
Something is blocking the door.
steps: Remove anything caught in the door.
Close it firmly until it latches.
Restart the cycle.
technician: If the code persists, the latch or door switch needs checking by Bosch service.

title: Care reminder
causes: The dryer is reminding you to run its care programme. It is not a fault.
steps: Run the basic care programme described in your manual.
technician: Not needed unless the reminder will not clear after the care programme.

title: Refrigerant temperature sensor short circuit
causes: The refrigerant temperature sensor has short-circuited.
steps: Note the fault code.
Switch the dryer off and do not keep using it.
Book a repair with Miele.
technician: This is a technical fault you cannot fix yourself. Book a Miele technician.

title: Refrigerant temperature sensor open circuit
causes: The circuit to the refrigerant temperature sensor is broken.
steps: Note the fault code.
Switch the dryer off and do not keep using it.
Book a repair with Miele.
technician: This is a technical fault you cannot fix yourself. Book a Miele technician.

title: Drying air temperature sensor short circuit
causes: The drying air temperature sensor has short-circuited.
steps: Note the fault code.
Switch the dryer off and do not keep using it.
Book a repair with Miele.
technician: This is a technical fault you cannot fix yourself. Book a Miele technician.

title: Drying air temperature sensor open circuit
causes: The circuit to the drying air temperature sensor is broken.
steps: Note the fault code.
Switch the dryer off and do not keep using it.
Book a repair with Miele.
technician: This is a technical fault you cannot fix yourself. Book a Miele technician.

title: Door signal mismatch
causes: The door and the door contact report different states.
steps: Note the fault code.
Switch the dryer off and do not keep using it.
Book a repair with Miele.
technician: This is a technical fault you cannot fix yourself. Book a Miele technician.

title: Electronic module fault
causes: The electronic module has a fault.
steps: Note the fault code.
Switch the dryer off and do not keep using it.
Book a repair with Miele.
technician: This is a technical fault you cannot fix yourself. Book a Miele technician.

title: Model type not programmed
causes: The model type is missing or the wrong variant is set in the electronics.
steps: Note the fault code.
Switch the dryer off and do not keep using it.
Book a repair with Miele.
technician: This is a technical fault you cannot fix yourself. Book a Miele technician.

title: Electronic module fault
causes: The electronic module has a fault.
steps: Note the fault code.
Switch the dryer off and do not keep using it.
Book a repair with Miele.
technician: This is a technical fault you cannot fix yourself. Book a Miele technician.

title: Drive motor or electronics fault
causes: The drive motor is defective.
The electronic module has a fault.
steps: Note the fault code.
Switch the dryer off and do not keep using it.
Book a repair with Miele.
technician: This is a technical fault you cannot fix yourself. Book a Miele technician.

title: Technical fault, dryer disabled
causes: A technical fault has disabled the dryer.
steps: Note the fault code.
Switch the dryer off and do not keep using it.
Book a repair with Miele.
technician: This is a technical fault you cannot fix yourself. Book a Miele technician.

title: Refrigerant sensor after condenser short circuit
causes: The refrigerant temperature sensor after the condenser has short-circuited.
steps: Note the fault code.
Switch the dryer off and do not keep using it.
Book a repair with Miele.
technician: This is a technical fault you cannot fix yourself. Book a Miele technician.

title: Refrigerant sensor after compressor short circuit
causes: The refrigerant temperature sensor after the compressor has short-circuited.
steps: Note the fault code.
Switch the dryer off and do not keep using it.
Book a repair with Miele.
technician: This is a technical fault you cannot fix yourself. Book a Miele technician.

title: Overload or software fault
causes: The drum is overloaded.
A software glitch, often shortly after the door was opened to add laundry.
A technical fault.
steps: Take some laundry out so the load matches the programme limit.
Switch the dryer off and straight back on.
Restart the programme.
technician: If F50 keeps coming back, contact Miele Customer Service.

title: Laundry not dry after maximum time
causes: The drum is overloaded.
Laundry was not spun fast enough in the washer.
The fluff filters are dirty.
steps: Reduce the load to the programme maximum.
Spin laundry at the highest suitable speed before drying.
Clean all fluff filters and dry them fully before refitting.
Run the programme again.
technician: If the fault persists with clean filters and a normal load, contact Miele Customer Service.

title: Airflow blocked (filters or ventilation)
causes: Fluff filters or the plinth filter are dirty.
The plinth filter is crusted, damaged or misshapen.
The drum is overloaded.
The vent grille is blocked or the room is poorly ventilated.
steps: Clean the fluff filters and the plinth filter, then squeeze the plinth filter dry.
Gently vacuum fluff from the heat exchanger without pressing on the fins.
Clear the ventilation grille under the door.
Reduce the load and air the room while drying.
Replace a damaged plinth filter.
technician: If F66 remains after thorough cleaning, contact Miele Customer Service.

title: No Wi-Fi connection
causes: Miele@home is not set up.
The dryer cannot reach your Wi-Fi.
steps: Set up Miele@home if not done yet.
Check that Wi-Fi is on and restart the router.
Improve signal with a repeater if it is weak.
Reset the dryer's Wi-Fi and connect it again.
technician: This is a connection message, not a dryer fault. Contact Miele if it cannot connect after these steps.

title: Motor overloaded
causes: The drum is overloaded.
Laundry is trapped in the drum.
A motor or drive fault.
steps: Open the door and check for trapped items.
Remove some laundry if the load is too big.
Close the door and restart.
If it remains, switch off power for about 1 minute, then restart.
technician: If E50 comes back repeatedly or the drum will not turn, book an AEG repair.

title: Door not closed
causes: Laundry is caught in the door.
The door seal or lock is dirty or worn.
The drum is overloaded and pushes on the door.
steps: Remove clothes caught in the door and close it until it clicks.
Wipe the door seal with a damp cloth.
Brush fluff out of the door lock.
Reduce the load.
Switch off power for 30 seconds, then restart.
technician: If the error persists, the lock or door sensor may be faulty. Book an AEG service visit.

title: Drainage or pump problem
causes: The drain hose is not connected properly.
The drain hose is twisted, blocked or looped.
steps: If you use a drain, check the hose is connected correctly.
Remove twists, loops and blockages from the hose.
Switch off power for 30 seconds, then restart.
technician: If the error persists, book an authorised AEG engineer.

title: Heating problem
causes: The dryer is built into a cabinet with no ventilation.
The room is too small or not ventilated.
Fluff filter, condenser or seal is dirty.
The heater is faulty.
steps: Make sure the dryer has space and air around it.
Open a window or door while drying in a small room.
Clean the fluff filter, condenser and door seal.
Run a timed programme and check if it is warm after 30 minutes.
technician: If it is still cold, book an AEG repair.

title: Temperature sensor fault
causes: The temperature sensor is faulty.
steps: Unplug the dryer for 2 hours to reset it.
Plug it back in and try again.
If the code returns, stop using the dryer and keep it unplugged.
technician: Contact AEG and quote the code for a service visit.

title: Programme selector or software fault
causes: The programme dial is between two positions.
A software fault.
steps: Turn the dial so it sits fully on one programme.
Unplug the dryer for 30 seconds, then plug back in and restart.
technician: If E80 remains, book an AEG service engineer.

title: Power supply problem
causes: Voltage is too low or too high.
The supply is unstable.
steps: Test the socket with another appliance.
Do not use an extension lead.
Unplug the dryer for 30 seconds, then restart.
technician: If another appliance also fails, call an electrician. If only the dryer shows the code, book an AEG technician.

title: Electrical noise detected
causes: Electrical interference on the supply.
Poor earthing.
steps: Try the dryer in a different, working socket.
Make sure the socket is properly earthed.
technician: If the code stays, contact an authorised AEG service centre. Do not attempt electrical repairs yourself.

title: Electronics fault
causes: A fault in the dryer's electronics.
steps: Stop using the dryer.
Unplug it and leave it unplugged.
technician: Book an authorised AEG engineer to diagnose the electronics.

title: Temperature sensor fault
causes: The temperature sensor has a problem.
steps: Stop using the dryer.
Unplug it until it has been checked.
technician: Book an AEG service visit to replace or check the sensor.

title: Moisture sensor problem
causes: The dryer is not plugged into an earthed socket.
The moisture measuring system is faulty.
steps: Check that the dryer is plugged into an earthed socket.
If the cycle still runs very long, stop using the dryer and unplug it.
technician: If the socket is earthed and the error remains, book an AEG repair.

title: Steam tank error (Iron Aid models)
causes: The steam water tank is low or empty.
steps: Fill the steam tank up to the MAX level.
Restart the programme.
technician: If the icons keep flashing after filling, stop using the dryer and contact an AEG service centre.

title: Circuit board fault
causes: A fault on the electronic control board.
steps: Unplug the dryer for at least 2 minutes.
Plug it back in, wait 30 seconds and try again.
technician: If F01 returns after the reset, call Hotpoint service to book an engineer.

title: Motor circuit fault
causes: A fault in the motor circuit. The drum turns only now and then or not at all.
steps: Switch the dryer off and unplug it.
Do not keep using it.
technician: Call Hotpoint service to book an engineer.

title: Temperature sensing fault
causes: The temperature sensor is faulty, so the dryer does not heat.
steps: Switch the dryer off and unplug it.
technician: Call Hotpoint service to book an engineer.

title: Blocked drain or pump problem
causes: A blockage in the pump filter (if fitted) or drain hose.
A blocked waste pipe.
A failed pump.
steps: Check and clean the pump filter if your model has one.
Check the drain hose and the plumbing it connects to for blockages.
technician: If everything is clear and the fault remains, the pump may have failed. Call Hotpoint service.

title: Door lock fault
causes: Something is obstructing the door lock.
The door lock is faulty.
steps: Check the door lock area for fluff or objects and clear them.
Close the door firmly and try again.
technician: If the fault remains, call Hotpoint service.

title: Software fault
causes: A software problem. Several lights may flash and no programme can be chosen.
steps: Unplug the dryer for a few minutes and try again.
technician: Call Hotpoint service to book an engineer.

title: Pump circuit fault
causes: The pump circuit has failed, so water is not pumped out.
steps: Empty the water container if your model has one.
Switch off and unplug the dryer.
technician: Call Hotpoint service to book an engineer.

title: Electronic control fault
causes: The electronic control is faulty. The dryer may not switch on.
steps: Check the plug and socket.
Unplug the dryer for a few minutes and try again.
technician: Call Hotpoint service to book an engineer.

title: Internal data error
causes: Corrupted internal data. Some display parts or functions do not work.
steps: Unplug the dryer for at least 2 minutes.
Plug it back in, wait 30 seconds and try again.
technician: If F18 remains after the reset, call Hotpoint service.

title: Motor circuit fault
causes: A fault in the motor circuit. The drum turns only now and then or not at all.
steps: Switch the dryer off and unplug it.
technician: Call Indesit service to book an engineer.

title: Temperature sensing fault
causes: The temperature sensor is faulty, so the dryer does not heat.
steps: Switch the dryer off and unplug it.
technician: Call Indesit service to book an engineer.

title: Blocked drain or pump problem
causes: A blockage in the pump filter (if fitted) or drain hose.
A failed pump.
steps: Check and clean the pump filter if your model has one.
Check the drain hose and plumbing for blockages.
technician: If everything is clear and the fault remains, call Indesit service.

title: Door lock fault
causes: Something is obstructing the door lock.
The door lock is faulty.
steps: Check the door lock for obstructions.
Close the door firmly and try again.
technician: If the fault remains, call Indesit service.

title: Software fault
causes: A software problem. Several lights may flash and no programme can be chosen.
steps: Unplug the dryer for a few minutes and try again.
technician: Call Indesit service to book an engineer.

title: Pump circuit fault
causes: The pump circuit has failed, so water is not pumped out.
steps: Empty the water container if your model has one.
Switch off and unplug the dryer.
technician: Call Indesit service to book an engineer.

title: Electronic control fault
causes: The electronic control is faulty. The dryer may not switch on.
steps: Check the plug and socket.
Unplug the dryer for a few minutes and try again.
technician: Call Indesit service to book an engineer.

title: Internal data error
causes: Corrupted internal data. Some display parts or functions do not work.
steps: Unplug the dryer for at least 2 minutes.
Plug it back in, wait 30 seconds and try again.
technician: If F18 remains after the reset, call Indesit service.

title: Restricted airflow
causes: The lint screen is clogged.
The vent is blocked, crushed, kinked or has too many bends.
steps: Clean the lint screen.
Check the vent for blockages, crushing or kinks.
Touch any key to clear the code.
technician: If the code keeps coming back with a clean vent, schedule Whirlpool service.

title: Low or no line voltage
causes: A household fuse has blown or a breaker has tripped.
The power cord is not installed correctly.
steps: Check your fuses and breakers (electric dryers use two) and reset them.
Check the power cord is installed as described in the installation guide.
Run a timed heated cycle and restart.
technician: If L2 stays, have a qualified electrician check the supply.

title: Power failure
causes: Power was interrupted during the cycle.
steps: Press and hold Start to resume the cycle.
Or press Power to clear the display.
technician: Not a fault. Contact Whirlpool only if PF appears without real power cuts.

title: Control unit or wiring problem
causes: A fault in the control unit or its wiring.
steps: Press Power, choose a cycle and press and hold Start.
If it does not start, unplug the dryer.
technician: If the problem continues, schedule Whirlpool service.

title: Control lock on
causes: The control lock has been switched on.
steps: Touch and hold Control Lock for 3 seconds until the display counts down and clears.
technician: This is not a fault. Contact Whirlpool only if the lock will not turn off.

title: Lint filter removed
causes: The HybridCare filter is not in the dryer.
steps: Put the filter back in.
Make sure the filter handle is fully seated.
technician: If LF stays with the filter in place, contact Whirlpool service.
